name: file-upload-panel
title: File upload panel
description: Controlled files/onFilesChange (add, progress, done, error, remove, cancel) or defaultFiles; manual uploadMode retains pending File objects for form submission. beforeUpload drops false, replaces a File or rejects without Retry; batches preserve pick order and expose aria-busy. onUpload receives {signal, id}: forward signal to fetch/XHR to stop the transport. Unmount and cancel abort; retry gets a fresh signal. onRemove runs before removal: false or rejection keeps a row, and promises disable its button. Pending rows use locale-aware binary sizes with compact unit labels (4,300 bytes: 4.2 KB); existing uploaded rows retain decimal sizes. Live examples: /preview.html?kind=block&id=file-upload-panel--manual-form and /preview.html?kind=block&id=file-upload-panel--auto-cancel. Drag-and-drop zone with accept/reject MIME feedback (demonstrated in the Labels preview), a Browse button, type and size validation, and a file list with progress, retry and remove. Optional labels?: Partial<FileUploadPanelLabels> overrides built-in copy; explicit props and validation messages win, then labels, then I18nProvider (en/es). No provider preserves English; fixtures and caller content stay unchanged. Interactive preview: /preview.html?kind=block&id=file-upload-panel--labels.
author: gntik-ai
